instruction: Move forward from the place where you are standing, you can see the open door to your right, exit the room through an open door. You can see stair case in-front of you, climb all the stair cases, you can see two photo frames in-front of you on the wall and the open door to the left of the wall enter into the room, walk along the corridor, enter into an open door in-front of you, now take left, move forward and now take right, you can see a photo frame on the left side of the wall, move forward now you will enter into a bed room, take left and stand between the white cupboards and the bed. That is your end point.
